    Bug 1957005 - Fix incorrect permission requirement for messages.tags.onDeleted. r=aleca
    
    
    The required permission is `messagesTagsList`, not `accountsRead`. This event
    only reports the deletion of a tag, and therefore only requires permission
    to list tags.
    
    Differential Revision: https://phabricator.services.mozilla.com/D271742

diff --git a/mail/components/extensions/schemas/messages.json b/mail/components/extensions/schemas/messages.json
index e1df7222e9f..30ce65607dc 100644
--- a/mail/components/extensions/schemas/messages.json
+++ b/mail/components/extensions/schemas/messages.json
@@ -1506,7 +1506,7 @@
         "name": "onDeleted",
         "type": "function",
         "description": "Fired when a message tag has been deleted.",
-        "permissions": ["accountsRead"],
+        "permissions": ["messagesTagsList"],
         "parameters": [
           {
             "type": "string",
title: Bug 1957005 - Fix incorrect permission requirement for messages.tags.onDeleted. r=aleca
